maria: Heads-up — enterprise customer asked for a stable tool-call results envelope across hosted/dedicated/private. They want minimal churn, clear error semantics, and telemetry hooks. can we decide scope for next milestone?
aj: thanks. is the ask mostly shape stability or behavior (retries/fallbacks)?
sanjay: both. shape stability + deterministic fallback to a smaller model variant when main model errors. they called out integrations that explode if fields are missing.
elaine: +1 on stable fields. also needs a version field so SDKs can gate behavior.
maria: proposal: v1 = required fields: tool_name, status, result, model_variant, call_id, timestamp. optional metadata map. version string at top. backward-compatible additions only after major bump. thoughts?
aj: sounds reasonable. what about error detail? customers want machine-readable retry hints instead of free text.
sanjay: agree — suggest status enum: success | soft_error | hard_error. soft_error includes retry_after (ms) and fallback_to (model_variant). hard_error includes code and user_message.
elaine: can we keep the envelope compact by default? a lot of customers hit token-cost limits when SDKs log large call metadata. maybe compress metadata or allow opt-in verbose telemetry.
maria: good point. propose we add `debug` boolean to request that triggers full metadata in response. default off.
aj: compatibility with binary outputs? some tools return base64 blobs. envelope should allow result.type and result.payload (string or base64). include result.encoding field. show example:
```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "tool_name": "pdf_extractor",
  "status": "success",
  "call_id": "c-1234",
  "model_variant": "redwood-llama-13b-q4",
  "result": {"type": "json", "payload": "{\"pages\":2}"}
}
```
sanjay: nice. also need an inner checksum for payload so clients can verify integrity when using cached results. add result.checksum.sha256 as optional.
elaine: telemetry hooks: include `trace_id` and `route_info` (leaky: region/model used) when `telemetry: true` on request. again opt-in for privacy.
maria: rollout plan: draft spec, run short eval against existing SDKs for compatibility, then ship as opt-in `tool_call_version=1` flag on the API for 2 weeks before making default. rollback path: keep old envelope if client requests `tool_call_version=legacy`.
aj: launch criteria: spec docs, SDK updates (python/js), regression tests for parser failures, 3 customer signoffs from pilot partners, perf test for added fields <1% tail latency impact.
sanjay: tech todo: runtime needs to add conditional envelope formatter, checksum generator, and fallback routing hints. estimate 3 dev-weeks + 1 week QA.
elaine: I can draft release notes and SDK examples once spec is in repo.
maria: action items: 1) aj draft PR with JSON schema + enum defs by EOD Tue, 2) sanjay produce perf/impl plan by Thu, 3) elaine mock SDK snippets by Fri. i'll ping legal about telemetry opt-ins.
aj: ack. I'll include sample parsing pseudocode snippet too.
sanjay: ack. adding GH issue and link here when created.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: eng-platform/toolcall-envelope spec draft -> staging on 1708766000 :rocket: 
maria: Thanks all — will sync again after PR reviews. :thumbsup:
